function.name: check_availability
function.description: Check if a date and time slot is available for an appointment. Call this before creating an appointment.

preferred_date.description: The requested date in YYYY-MM-DD format e.g. 2026-06-10

preferred_time.description: The requested time in HH:MM format e.g. 14:00

appointment_id.description: The ID or reference code of the existing appointment to modify/reschedule (optional, used to disregard the current booking's table from availability checks when rescheduling).

function.name: create_appointment
function.description: Save a new appointment after collecting all details from the caller and confirming them back.

service.description: Type of appointment or service requested

notes.description: Any special requests or additional notes

function.name: modify_appointment
function.description: Reschedule or update an existing appointment.

appointment_id.description: The UUID, SevenRooms ID, or Reference Code of the appointment to modify

function.name: cancel_appointment
function.description: Cancel an existing appointment. Always confirm with the caller before calling this.

appointment_id.description: The UUID of the appointment to cancel

function.name: get_guest_profile
function.description: Look up the caller's active reservation by phone number or name. Call this at the start of any modify or cancel flow — the system resolves the caller's number automatically. Returns: found (bool), multiple_bookings (bool), and either a single booking's details or a bookings[] array when the guest has more than one upcoming reservation. If multiple_bookings=true, you MUST read back each booking's date and time and ask the caller which one they mean before taking any action.

phone.description: The phone number of the customer (optional; if not provided, the caller's current number is automatically resolved).

name.description: The name of the customer (optional; used if looking up by name instead of phone).

function.name: add_to_cancellation_list
function.description: Add the guest to the restaurant's waitlist / cancellation list when the requested time slot has no availability.

guest_name.description: The full name of the guest.

guest_phone.description: The phone number of the guest (preferably including country code).

guest_email.description: The email address of the guest (optional).

function.name: route_transfer
function.description: Resolve the correct staff phone number to transfer the call to based on the escalation reason (e.g. complaint, private_event, group_booking, lost_and_found, supplier, etc.).

reason.description: The reason for the transfer. You MUST use one of these exact strings — do not invent others: 'reservation_issue' (booking not found or cannot be modified/cancelled), 'group_booking' (party of more than 10), 'private_event' (buyout, corporate dining, private room, events), 'press' (press, media, influencer), 'supplier' (supplier or delivery driver), 'job_application' (job applications or CVs), 'complaint' (any complaint), 'lost_and_found' (lost property), 'allergy' (allergy or dietary queries beyond basics), 'gift_voucher' (gift voucher purchases), 'corporate_invoice' (corporate accounts or invoices), 'takeaway' (takeaway, delivery, or ordering issues), any configured partner-venue key (transfer to that venue), 'default' (anything else).

function.name: get_menu_recommendations
function.description: Retrieve menu recommendations based on optional category, search query (like vegan or specific dish names), or allergens to exclude.

exclude_allergens.description: List of allergen names or numbers to exclude (e.g. ['Gluten', 'Milk', 'Nuts', '8']).

function.name: endCall
function.description: End the call. Call this immediately after saying goodbye or ending the call.
